data.status: plans to open in Prosper by the end of the year
data.short_description: Home2Suites by Hilton plans to open a location on Coleman Street near downtown Prosper by the end of the year. The extended-stay hotel will offer studio and one-bedroom suites with full kitchens, free hot breakfast, a fitness center and an outdoor pool.
Mama Cafe opened on November 4 in the former Mama Wok space next to 7-Eleven, under new ownership. The menu features Chinese and other Asian dishes, dim sum, sushi and house specialties.

Mama Wok, a local Chinese/Taiwanese concept that opened in Montgomery County in the early 1990s, operated several Rockville locations. Its longtime Key West Avenue restaurant closed earlier this year.
Topeka French restaurant Chez Yasu announced on Facebook that it is closing after 24 years. It will be open Thursday, Friday and Saturday, with Saturday, Nov. 7 as its final day of service.

The Capri's Meridian location, opened at the end of 2020, closed "until further notice," and its last day was Sunday according to a note in the window. No reason was given, and the original Boise location at 2520 W. Fairview Ave. is still operating.

data.short_description: A new Great Clips hair salon will soon open at 1611 E Borgfeld Drive, Suite 101. What Now confirmed the opening with a representative of the franchisee, and further details are pending.

Oklahoma Children's Behavioral Health Center celebrated the grand opening of its $140 million facility on Wednesday. The center has 72 inpatient beds and outpatient programs expected to serve 14,000 children annually.
Edmonton-based Pho Hoan Pasteur held the grand opening of its Sherwood Park location on Nov. 4, its sixth in the area. The location is offering 15% off from Nov. 4 to Nov. 18.

data.location: Historic J.A. Wilson Building, Asheville, N.C.
data.short_description: Limones, a Mexican- and Californian-inspired restaurant open since 2004, will close on November 14 as its managers retire. Reservations made for after November 14 will be canceled.
Smoke on the Water will reopen at 64 Beacon Drive near Pelham Road and I-85 on Friday, Nov. 6. The restaurant is taking walk-ins this week while finishing touches are completed.
Smoke on the Water closed its downtown Greenville location in 2024 after 10 years in business. No reason was announced, though rising rent had been reported as a concern.

Shorty's Bar-B-Q will close its Dadeland location after 75 years to make room for a new development. The restaurant, a landmark along U.S. 1 since 1951, will serve its final meal on December 27, 2026.

A WARN notice filed by operator Worthy Integrated Holdings LLC said the Oxnard Chick-fil-A would close by Dec. 31, affecting 87 employees. The current franchise holder said the restaurant is not actually closing but is being sold to another franchisee.

The NoMad hotel brand will open NoMad Detroit at Michigan Central Station, with reporting calling for a 2027 opening. Sydell Group and Hilton are behind the project, which will convert the station's former dining room and carriage house into dining and bar concepts.

The new ExtraMile Chevron gas station and convenience store on Skidaway Road is hosting a grand opening celebration starting at 10 a.m. on Nov. 5. The public event will feature free food and drinks, giveaways, prizes and a live DJ.

Felipe's Mexican Kitchen opened Monday in Jeffersonville, expanding from its two Louisville-area locations. The restaurant serves traditional Mexican dishes and has a full bar.
Grappler's Grove opened its facility on Bell Mill Side Road in January after starting in a temporary space in 2025. It offers jujitsu, freestyle wrestling, kickboxing and MMA classes.
